events.title: Employee is killed when ejected and crushed by ATV rollover…

events.title: Employee experiences seizure in fall off roof, dies of head…

The tanker was carrying gasoline and diesel fuel. The employee died as a result of his injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off ladder

The room has a main door and a smaller man-door; the man-door was open and the employee was right inside. The employee was killed due to oxygen deficiency.
